title: Lane Change
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Lane_Change.md
text: Generate commands to conduct lane change maneuvers, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Lane change type, changeType} sets Type of lane change to conduct Double lane change; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Inertial longitudinal position of gate extrance, XGate [m]} sets the global longitudinal position of start of gate, {Longitudinal entrance velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal entrance velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {Distance after target speed to begin reference, xStart [m]} sets the longitudinal offset, {Vehicle width, vehWidth [m]} sets the nominal vehicle width, {Lateral offset, nomLatOffset [m]} sets the nominal lateral offset, {Lateral reference position breakpoints, latRefbp [m]} sets the longitudinal path breakpoints 1-by- n, {Lateral reference data, latRef [m]} sets the lateral path reference points 1-by-7, {Use reference data} sets the option to use reference data, {Stop simulation on course exit} sets the option to stop simulation on course exit, {Output info bus} sets the option to output info bus, {Instantiate 3D cones (Simulation 3D Scene Configuration required)} sets the option to instantiate 3D cones and {Show Maneuver Plot} sets the option to visualize. Values come from the instance.
